answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to lock a refundable stake bond before trading, like a ferrous anchor holding a ship: creating a thousand fake agents means locking a thousand bonds, so the attack cost scales linearly with the number of fakes. Honest agents earn their bond back plus fees, while proven fraud forfeits it. A public mirror ledger records every bond and slash, so no velvet glove hides a repeat offender history; buyers simply refuse counterparties with thin or slashed bonds, making fakery expensive and unprofitable.
